name: Structure: Fix the rule that the read on the center may never become a rating, a case file, a read of a founder's feelings or outside commitments, a room, or a trigger for the operating agreement
text_content:
P11. The read on the center is the record's cooling failure and node overload lines applied to the founding seats and nothing else: never a rating, a rank, a score, or a mark on any founder; never a case file, a performance record, or a file the operating agreement's process could cite; never a read of a founder's feelings, energy, mood, health, life, or commitments outside the house; never a room, an item at any brief, or a word in the roster's hearing; never a trigger for the operating agreement, a vote, or a founder's departure; never a founder's judgment of another founder written as anything but a question on a page; never a lead's impression, a survey, an outside instrument, or a founders' 360. Written on the mechanism map beside Session 15's staying rule (17tn048qg2e), Session 14's two rules (17tn048qfnz, 17tn048qfp0), Session 13's no-pay-input rule (17tn048qeu8), Session 12's no-page rule (17tn048qckt), Session 11's record-first rule (17tn048qc3y), and Session 10's no-person-in-a-room rule (86akht2k9), as the one thing on the S16 page a later session cannot revise at ordinary cost. High.

Filed by Session 16 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjz6. Reasoning lives on the S16 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
